notes.title: Trading Cards, New Languages and Fixes
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30843688/5d1bb94b60ee3f4cf64438e0ad5fedd51db5481f.gif[/img]

Hello friends, how's your 2024 so far?

Mine is great, working hard to update all of my previously released games, focused on feedback got from players and making them more accessible with the addition of new languages,

And it's time for Blackout Z. Here's what changed:
[h2]New Languages[/h2]
[list][*] Spanish
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Japanese
[*] Korean[/list]
Making it now 9 languages supported (more will come on a future update).
[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list][*]Fixed an issue by players with monitors of different resolutions having issues with the pause and game over screens.
[*]Improved hud and menus readability and fonts to make the visuals more consistent. [/list]
[h2]Trading Cards[/h2]
Valve aproved Blackout Z to have trading cards!!!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30843688/7bd4ef92ec17592ee68394da604aac916b959dd3.png[/img]

As aways, thanks for all the support across the multiple games I released so far. 

I'm also working on Burning Skies, my most ambitious project, a roguelite shmup, built completely in 3D, I would love if you guys could check it out:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915690/Burning_Skies



Also, join in our discord server, for exclusive updates on things I'm working

[url=https://discord.nukgames.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30843688/b0de87358daff2a907e1a741b5aa5e517ddfbaf7.gif[/img][/url]

notes.title: Burning Skies Arcade - Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/7243354/040b707d40275c5971df644db46612103b8b95ef.gif[/img]

Hello folks, based on your feedback I've worked for the last weeks, on an update for the Burning Skies Arcade Demo, here's what changed:

[h2]Improvements/Fetures[/h2]
[list][*] Highscore
[*] Saving the settings and Hiscore
[*] A little tutorial at the beggining of the demo
[*] Feedback when the player picks a power up
[*] Ajusted audio mastering[/list]
[h2]New Content[/h2]
[list][*] New Range Power Up[/list]
[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[list][*] Adjusted the space between projectiles on one of the boss's attacks[/list]
[h2]Bugfixes[/h2]
- Wall creation with missing parts
- Audio didn't set to zero
- Glitch when music interlapping
- glitch engine sfx interlapping
- when pausing at the beggining the menu whould not show up
 
Check the free demo here: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2290190/Burning_Skies_Arcade/

As aways, thanks for your support, and please join our discord and tell me what do you think of this new update. 

[url=https://discord.nukgames.com/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43802060/ac01faddf114bfe95350f607d1767587e9d027bb.gif[/img][/url]


Burning Skies Arcade is a freeware version of Burning Skies, a bigger roguelite shmup that we'll release next year, please wishlist it so you'll receive updates when we have any news

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1915690/Burning_Skies/

notes.title: Cyberhunt MASSIVE UPDATE.
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/70a6c68e45527e58b17eb9882f1193eaf1382f53.gif[/img]
Hello friends, I have been silent for the past few months, and the reason for that is that I was making a huge update to CYBERHUNT, I basically remade it from the ground up. 
[list][*] Changed the game engine
[*] All graphics remade
[*] New missions system
[*] Enemies IA remade and added 2 new enemies (tank and missile)
[*] Controls improved and modernized
[*] New SFX
[*] and A LOT MORE... [/list]
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/cc897322bf3be83f5a06389364af52f19618cf1c.gif[/img]
In case you prefer, you can also access the original version of CYBERHUNT by selecting the option when launching the game. 

I choose to release this as a update and not as a sequel to thank you all for all the support and give some back to the communty that gave me so much!
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/15171fc99f2047ac411bb1ad47fa1b13a46ea3c8.gif[/img]
Please let me know if you enjoyed this update, it took a lot of time and work to make it, maybe I'll do something like this with another of my titles if I feel that you guys liked.

My newest game is on sale right now, for the lowest price EVER, please check it out. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1143900/Shapeshooter/
As aways thank you very much for all the support.
Paulo

Hello friends, with giveaway of [b]POLYGONEER[/b] the playerbase of the game has grown exponentially and some of the new players reported dificulties to play the game with different keyboard layouts. So I updated the game following this requests:

- Support to QWERTY, QWERTZ and AZERTY layouts (just acces the config on the options menu)
- 10 Options to change the sensitivity that the turret rotates (default is 5) 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/a805c1949ae29753010a97cc2879a97f3b44f008.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Razortron 2084 - Devlog #7
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34745944/c1989960f2d7b9cf5c748fc05c22ed041b6f0adb.gif[/img]

Hello friends, for this devlog I would like to highlight the Pseudo 3D buildings that I managed to develop for Razortron 2084, with this I'll be able to make much preetier and more diverse scenarios, you  can see on the gif above, the algorithm turns flat 2d images into pseudo 3D images. I also changed a litte bit the art direction on the game, to be more 'texturized' (what do you think about this) It can be seen better on the first screenshot on the game's page.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1052650/Razortron_2084/
(add to your wishlist and follow to receive updates on the development)

Some other things that I finished or are almost done
- Traffic IA
- Traffic and road generation for the arcade mode
- In-game color switch (this is usefull to come with cool color schemes)
- Joystick Support.

Now the things are moving much faster and I'll announce more features on the future weeks. 

Thank you very much for all the support, friends

[url=https://twitter.com/ThisIsNuk]Paulo Brunassi[/url]
NukGames

notes.title: Devlog #4 - Razortron sequel
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/a19c40547524e6880d95a36d08af3f2258338ca4.gif[/img]

Hello friends, how was your blackfriday?

I'm back with the fourth devlog, and this time the update is preety big:

[list][*]The skeleton of the first circuit is done (the edges are rough, but will be fixed soon) ;
[*]A basic AI is set(will work a lot on it soon);
[*]A new sprite for the first of the many cars the game will have, this one is bigger so I could put more details into it; 
[*]Completely remade the camera system and I think it's very smooth now, maybe will apply some zoom in and out sometime soon.
[*]Developed a tool to change the neon color ingame, I'll implement it on the final game too.(it can be seen on 45 seconds of the video)[/list]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=sPi1ToYoRYM&t=3s
[b]Final thoughts[/b]
After working for almost two months on the game, the shape and direction of it is much more clear for me, and I think the development speed will increase now.

ps. On this weekend I'll be joining the Ludum Dare, so if you'll like to follow the development please follow me on twitter, after the game is done, I'll post here too.

Thank you very much for all the support I've been receiving during this years, you guys are great!

Paulo Brunassi

notes.title: Polygoneer Update + Very Positive Ratings
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/684680/Polygoneer/][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7243354/af30887ed7731da51b2cc6e88e797509b452f369.gif[/img][/url]

Hello friends, I'm happy with all the feedback on [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/684680/Polygoneer/]Polygoneer[/url][/b] and glad it reached the status of very positive.

To celebrate I'm updating it with a better balancing and adding 3 new languages!

[list][*]Added the languages German, Russian and Simplified chinese.
[*]Balanced the spawning and speed of the enemies in all stages.[/list]

Thank you all for the great feedback, and if you have any comment on the update just drop a message on the community forum.

If you like my games and what I'm doing, please follow my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/NukGames]creators page[/url] on Steam, and keep reviewing my games, this is the most important for me to keep making games and improving as a developer.

Update #1 - ver 1.01
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30843688/119b77d236fb171dc1652c34a827b12ced987caa.gif[/img]
Hello friends, this is the first update for [b]Blackout Z[/b] and I have only to thank you guys for the great reception the game had so far. Here's the changes:

[list][*]Added V-Sync to the game (some player reported a huge framerate).
[*]Fixed a bug that makes the game crashes when the game doesn't find a zombie body.
[*]Added Steam Cloud support.[/list]

Thanks again to everyone playing and recomending the game. Please if you enjoyed the game make sure to leave a brief Steam review, that helps A LOT for a small game like this to get some visibility on Steam. 

Paulo Brunassi
[url=https://twitter.com/ThisIsNuk]NukGames[/url]

Please check my other game [b]Polygoneer[/b], it's a small fast paced arcade game where you have to hit the polygon with the right color before it's too late.
http://store.steampowered.com/app/684680/Polygoneer/
